notes: Software updates are now re-checked while the app runs - the manifest was polled once, 15s after launch, so a version published while TDQSYS was already open went unnoticed until a manual restart. It now re-checks every 30 minutes and still checks on launch. Settings can no longer be stranded: a permanent Settings link now sits at the bottom of the hub and is never removed by the local/website filter, since Settings is where updates live and a hub that hides it can leave you stuck on an old build. Also: full local hub restored (Facilitator Dashboard, TV Display + Video Ads, Mobile Status Viewer) while https://tdqsys.pages.dev/ still publishes only the Mobile Status Viewer; /display is a real 404; a bare /client with no ?id= shows a 'No location selected' panel instead of silently rendering another location's queue.
